defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.demonstratedBy: node scripts/build-census-v1-wa_blake_vacatur_and_lfo_refund-set.mjs --check at 52988d70 exits with WashingtonPacketBuildError: source absent from verified corpus: private/source-imports/rcap-d-source-packs-2026-08-12/D2/STATES/WA/02_PACKET_FORMS/WA__FORM__BLAKE-001__blake-001-record-vacatur-form__REV-2026-04__EN.pdf
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.whyItIsADefect: The custody row binds BLAKE-001 twice — by form label at STATES/WA/02_PACKET_FORMS/... and by content hash at the import-pack path. Both bindings carry SHA-256 a4d2098f63907b6f0fe1e2c400c0dd960a9d313c5968407d80c88d9ecae05b0f, so they are one document held at two paths in two custody roots. loadDocuments resolved every binding against the Master Library root alone and read the second binding as a fourth document missing from the corpus.
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.repair: loadDocuments now keys loaded documents by SHA-256. A later binding with an already-loaded digest is verified against the committed corpus index (path, SHA-256, byte length, page count), recorded on the document as an additionalCustodyBinding, and its bytes are not re-opened from a mount this container does not hold. Form number, byte length and page count must agree or the build still fails.
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.noSubstitutionWasMade: No file was substituted, no revision was swapped and no locator page was accepted for a form. Every document still comes from bytes hashed in this container and checked against the pinned custody SHA-256.
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.scopeOfTheChange: The dedup path only triggers when two custody bindings share a digest. Of the ten Washington families this script serves, only wa_blake_vacatur_and_lfo_refund-set has a content_hash binding, so the other nine load exactly as before.

defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.demonstratedBy: node scripts/build-census-v1-wa_blake_vacatur_and_lfo_refund-set.mjs --self-test at 52988d70 exits with AssertionError 4 !== 3 at selfTest (dry.sourceCount).
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.whyItIsADefect: --dry-run reported records.custody.documentSources.length, which counts custody bindings, while the self-test asserted the document count. The two diverged the moment a second binding of one document entered the custody row, and the self-test has been red since.
defectsFoundAndRepairedInTheBuilder.repair: --dry-run now reports custodyBindingCount (4) and sourceCount as distinct documents by digest (3); the self-test asserts both. It now passes: WA_PACKET_BUILDER_SELF_TEST_OK.

whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.firstFinding: The build worklist assigns 'lfo_refund_claim: Blake-002'. The pinned BLAKE-002 bytes print their own footer as '(04/2026) CLJ Blake Motion' and their title as 'Blake Motion to Vacate Drug Possession Conviction and Refund Paid LFO Amounts'. BLAKE-002 is the courts-of-limited-jurisdiction counterpart of BLAKE-001, not a separate refund-claim vehicle. This finding was already in the builder; reading the bytes in this shift confirmed it.
whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.secondFindingMeasuredInThisShift: BLAKE-001 prints '(04/2026) Superior Court Blake Motion (MT)' and the only held order, BLAKE-005, prints '(05/2025) Blake Full Vacat e Order CLJ'. The held order matches the CLJ motion, not the Superior Court motion the worklist names as the primary filing. No Superior Court Blake vacate order is bound to this family, so the declared primary filing has no matching proposed order in custody.
whyThisFamilyIsStillStopped.whyNotBuiltAnyway: Delivering a Superior Court motion with a courts-of-limited-jurisdiction order, or writing a Superior Court order that is not held, would invent packet topology and would tell a participant to file the wrong instrument in the wrong court. Neither was done and no component was inferred.

defectFoundInTheDeliveredBytesAndRepaire.demonstratedBy: The delivered record said the printed captions were "corroborated by Colorado's authored field name" and cited "two of this packet's sibling Colorado forms". This is a North Dakota packet built from one North Dakota form, and no Colorado document is bound to it.
defectFoundInTheDeliveredBytesAndRepaire.whyItIsADefect: The caption-evidence record exists so a reviewer can tell a checked caption basis from a guessed one. Naming the wrong authority for the authored field names, and citing sibling documents that are not in the packet, makes the evidence unreadable as evidence. It is copy-paste residue in the builder, not a rendering fault.
defectFoundInTheDeliveredBytesAndRepaire.repair: The builder now names the authority that actually authored the AcroForm field names — the North Dakota Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation, in SFN 61663 — and the false sibling-forms sentence is gone. Nothing else changed: both fixture SHA-256s are byte-identical before and after the repair.
